description: This file defines a Java class 'FlexibleControls' responsible for creating a GUI panel with input fields and a button to convert expressions from a human-readable form to RPN (Reverse Polish Notation) using a mathematical evaluator.

classes.name: FlexibleControls
classes.description: A class that provides a Swing GUI component for expression input and conversion to RPN.

methods.name: FlexibleControls
methods.description: Constructor that sets up the GUI components and initializes the expression processing.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Converts the input human-readable expression into RPN using DoubleEvaluator and updates the display.

methods.name: getPanel
methods.description: Returns the main JPanel containing the controls.
